SELECT r.room_no AS roomNo, r.room_name AS roomName, r.room_limit AS roomLimit, CASE WHEN res.room_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reservationStatus FROM room r LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT room_no FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date = #{date} AND reservation_option = #{time} ) res ON r.room_no = res.room_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (room_no, reservation_date, reservation_option, reservation_id, reservation_count, provider) VALUES (#{roomNo}, #{reservationDate}, #{reservationOption}, #{reservationId}, #{reservationCount}, #{provider} )
mapper.select: SELECT room_no AS roomNo, reservation_date AS reservationDate, reservation_option AS reservationOption, reservation_count AS reservationCount, provider AS provider FROM reservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY reservation_date DESC, createdate DESC
